approval_order: Approve this amendment as an owner/successor/gap binding for the 16 UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER lines without changing line-level disposition counts and without granting authority.

WP-1: donor byte closure for 35 untracked registry files and supplementary LegacyVsMovementGap paths, including directory-level crawlers/graph/indexer/writing/collect/extraction/streamplus references.
WP-3: worker-required vertical slices bind ingest registry, source-library single-source guard, search/discovery retrieval readback and task line-event semantics with parity/readback/recovery traces.

WP-4: horizontal service ports for request identity, task-readback metadata, single-source guard, agent-batch quality promotion and runtime health matrix with explicit effect/failure/authority/recovery tests.
WP-5: llm report export/audit/token/trend family under C8.3 admission with durable token/audit/trend realization.
WP-6: successor cells or explicit loss/no-call records for projects/config, dashboard/admin/governance, runtime ops, business-line evidence matrix and remaining backend surfaces.
Rerun the movement inventory with all required fields and line-level UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER == 0 before any candidate/authority/cutover milestone; keep live/provider/cutover authority separate.
risks: All 16 line-level blockers remain UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER after this recommendation because no line has a complete named successor realization plus acceptance trace for every frozen donor source; this blocks promotion/candidate/authority as required by governance.
35 donor registry files and named untracked families are absent from clean donor HEAD and the migration worktree; byte freeze depends on dirty working-tree snapshots until WP-1 closure.

Agent-batch quality promotion has an evidence omission (no gap row for search_quality_replay.py/executor_health.py) and runtime-health-matrix has no dedicated gap row; both require additive records before closure.
C1-C9 movement-level UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER == 0 does not imply all-lines coverage: 15 unmapped gaps and these 16 line records are outside that P1-P3 declared scope.
C7 matrix, capability specs and adoption reviews remain local-only inputs; none are promoted and candidate remains null.
Directory-level donor paths in LegacyVsMovementGap are not expanded in BackendDonorSurfaceInventory; WP-1 must expand them before byte-closure claims.
Credential values and codex_auth/llm configs were treated structurally only; no credential reads are claimed.
This amendment is a recommendation draft, not a supervisor acceptance record; it does not change freeze bytes or authority.
